description: One case per toggle: the estate with lateDeliveryCheckOff on and nothing else. The known answer is F-LATE-DELIVERY-CHECK, the Finding of Check LATE-DELIVERY-CHECK, whose severity (High) and fix are the Check's. The narration must name that problem and no other.

setup.toggle: lateDeliveryCheckOff, switched on alone from the fixed estate: infra/as-found.sh fixed, then infra/as-found.sh lateDeliveryCheckOff=true

input: Run an Estate health check and tell me what you found.

explanation.rubric: Says the health check found a problem matching: The Late delivery check is off. Does not report any other problem, and does not say the estate is healthy.
